what_happened: Scene L10 (same kitchen as s7 and success s15): green sponge_6 on white marble, rotated ~20 deg to the gripper, dark holed cutting_board_2 ~25 cm to the right. Stage 0: the fingers closed on the sponge at 96-100 (width 0.056) off-centre on the rotated sponge. As the arm rose at 104-108 they slid off its edge and closed on air (0.006); stage 0 held only at 98. The policy carried on toward the board with the empty, closed gripper (108-160; wrist view shows the board at right), then came back and hovered over the sponge with closed fingers (160-268, eef 6-16 cm). At 268-284 it opened the gripper, descended (300-336), re-grasped at 341 and lifted at ~346 (stage 0 from 346, online 352; median 111). Stage 1 then looked normal: it carried the sponge onto the board (380), counted contacts from 456, met the criterion at 559 (5 contacts, sweep 0.139) and kept scrubbing (8 contacts, sweep 0.213 by 705). At 800 it was still scrubbing with the sponge in hand, 344 steps after its first board contact (successes release 153-601 steps after it, median ~361).
causal_chain: off-centre grasp on the rotated sponge slipped at 104 -> empty carry 108-160 and hover 160-268 -> opened and re-grasped at 341-346 (stage 0 ~235 steps late) -> stage 1 progressed normally (criterion met 559) but the 800-step horizon ended before the release
self_recovery: Yes for stage 0: after ~160 steps of empty-handed motion and hovering, it reopened the gripper and re-grasped at 341. That came too late for stage 1.

packet_facts: close_events 87 width 0.052 touching sponge, not lifted

uncertain_about: Whether the policy would have released within a typical scrub time if it had had more steps.
